python_only_boundaries.dynamic_names: Python returns string-keyed offset dictionaries; native names resolve once during prepare and results use direct ID slots.
python_only_boundaries.dynamic_protocols: Python permits monkey-patched attributes and arbitrary mapping protocols; native preparation accepts frozen concrete typed attributes.
python_only_boundaries.native_batches: Configurable deterministic worker batches are a native throughput extension; Python exposes scalar checks only.
python_only_boundaries.unbounded_labels: Python node labels and integers are unbounded objects; native graph vertices and registry IDs use frozen bounded integer types.
